title: Thai Oozy Wrap
description: A delicious Thai-inspired wrap filled with oozy cheese, creamy sauce, and egg.

ingredients.name: Creamy sauce
ingredients.notes: like Thai peanut sauce or a dairy-based sauce

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the beaten egg to the pan and scramble it until cooked through.
Add the shredded oozy cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
Add the creamy sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Warm the Tunisian flatbread wrap in the pan for a few seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the egg and cheese mixture onto the wrap.
